denominator: deep dives and reader digests (name pass), WN capture and IF epubs (free scan); see nameSources per row

split.rule: A row whose sha1(id) first byte is below 0x33 (about a fifth) is held out (GKM429); the ids are fixed by the merge table in scripts/rezero_power_canon.mjs, committed before any grammar pass.

capabilities.death-checkpoint-rewind: Rewinds the world on the holder's death to a hidden checkpoint that moves on events, memory-only carry (R1, R2, R3)
capabilities.speech-penalty: A penalty keyed to the speaker and the act of telling, with a site exemption (R25)
capabilities.mind-binding: Binds, alters or compels another mind (verb bind or alter on mind)
capabilities.memory-erasure: Removes a name or memory from other minds and records (R10, R11)
capabilities.power-transfer: A power that moves to a successor on the holder's death or by selection (R6, R12)
capabilities.holder-mind-drift: The power warps its holder over time (PWC6)
capabilities.spirit-contract-judgement: Contract breach judged by the contractor's belief and wording (R30)
capabilities.protection-field: A ward or shield around a person or place that stops harm (PWC27)
capabilities.divination: Learns what is hidden, distant or to come by a power (PWC27)
capabilities.mind-state: Changes the holder's or another's mood, senses or will without binding it (PWC27)
capabilities.containment-rule: A power held in a place or vessel by a rule or seal (PWC27)
capabilities.formation-field: An arranged ground or circle that sets the field the power acts in (PWC27)
capabilities.power-interaction: The effect depends on another power meeting or cancelling it (PWC27)
capabilities.effect-unknown: The evidence states no effect to express
